_comment: FIL provider registry. Mirrors memory/corpora/registry.json in spirit: providers are DATA, not code. Vendor names appear here and in financial_data/providers/* only — never in gateway, agent, skill, or route code (the P8 seam). Adding a provider = adding an entry + a module with fetch(); no caller changes. `pit_capable` lists the kinds for which this provider can honestly answer an `as_of` query; a kind absent from that list still serves data, but the gateway will stamp as_of_honored=false so the caller knows the point-in-time guarantee does NOT hold.

sec-edgar.name: SEC EDGAR / XBRL companyfacts
sec-edgar.notes: As-reported values keyed by FILING date. This is the primary fundamentals source precisely because `filed` is a first-class field: restatements appear as separate entries rather than overwriting history, which is what makes true point-in-time queries possible for free.

yfinance.name: Yahoo Finance (via yfinance)
yfinance.notes: Demoted to fallback, not deleted (it is the incumbent price source for the 7-agent pipeline). Low reliability reflects unannounced schema drift and silent gaps, not price inaccuracy.

caveats.bars: Split/dividend adjustments are applied RETROACTIVELY: availability is point-in-time correct (a bar dated D was knowable at D's close), but the adjusted VALUE of an old bar changes after later corporate actions, so a value read today may differ from what a trader saw then. Availability guarantee holds; value stability does not.

tiingo.name: Tiingo daily bars
tiingo.notes: Key-gated: activates when TIINGO_API_KEY is in .env; until then it raises NotConfiguredError and the gateway falls through to yfinance with a warning naming the variable. Priority 40 (above yfinance's 50) so a configured key silently upgrades the bars path to a documented API.

caveats.bars: Adjusted OHLC (adj* fields): same retroactive-adjustment caveat as yfinance — availability PIT-correct, value stability not.

fred.name: FRED macro series (St. Louis Fed)
fred.notes: Keyless via the public fredgraph.csv endpoint. Series: DGS10/DGS2/T10Y2Y/FEDFUNDS/UNRATE/CPIAUCSL/VIXCLS (+ any valid FRED id).

caveats.macro: CURRENT VINTAGE ONLY: macro series are routinely revised and this endpoint overwrites history with revisions (true vintages need ALFRED). pit_capable is empty on purpose — as_of queries get as_of_honored=false. Live context yes; backtesting on these numbers no.

cboe.name: CBOE VIX daily history
cboe.notes: Keyless full VIX OHLC history 1990->today (symbol VIX / ^VIX / VIXCLS only). Bar-date availability is honest (published at close, not restated).

finnhub.name: Finnhub earnings calendar
finnhub.notes: Key-gated earnings calendar (dates + consensus EPS, past actuals). Future events are status=estimate with available_at=retrieval time; calendars shift, so pit_capable is empty.
